title: Cohomology of a finite coproduct is the product of component cohomologies
statement: Let $C=\coprod_{i\in I}C_i$ be a finite coproduct of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] with each inclusion $C_i\hookrightarrow C$ open and closed. For an abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], the canonical restriction maps identify $H^q(C,F)$ with the finite product $\prod_{i\in I}H^q(C_i,F|_{C_i})$ for every $q\ge 0$, where $F|_{C_i}=\iota_i^{-1}F$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] along the inclusion $\iota_i:C_i\hookrightarrow C$.

proof.text: The coprojections are open immersions: transport the standard coprojections along the unique isomorphism between the standard coproduct cofan and the given colimit cofan. Apply the clopen sheaf product theorem to obtain that R = pi-prime of the inverse-image functors is an equivalence, hence fully faithful.

Work with the library definition Sheaf.H as Ext from the constant integer sheaf. Each coprojection is etale, so inverse image is exact and preserves injective abelian sheaves. The latter is the proved abelian-group version injective_upperStar_obj_of_etale_addCommGrp in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.TorsionAcyclic, following the exact extension-by-zero adjunction of the etale-restriction-injectives node. Enough injectives is already an instance for the source etale sheaf category.

The proved private helper mapExt_family_bijective shows that a fully faithful family of exact injective-preserving functors induces a bijection from Ext(M,N,q) to the product of component Ext groups. In degree zero this is full faithfulness and Ext.mk-zero bijectivity. For the successor degree choose an injective presentation N to J and its cokernel Q. The exact rows Ext(M,J,q) to Ext(M,Q,q) to Ext(M,N,q+1) to zero compare with their componentwise images. Exactness of the product row is proved by choosing preimages coordinatewise; its last map is surjective because the component images of J are injective. Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and mapExactFunctor_extClass make the squares commute. Apply the additive right-exact five lemma and the induction hypothesis. This entire helper is proved in Lean, with no postponed assertion.

Apply the helper with M the constant integer sheaf and N=F. Precompose each component Ext group with the canonical isomorphism from the component constant integer sheaf to its inverse image. Each precomposition is an additive equivalence, so their dependent product is an equivalence. Its composite with the helper map is definitionally the family cohomologyMap of the statement; bijectivity follows by composition.
